title_zh: 全球健康与长寿每日简报
intro_zh: 每日汇总功能医学、长寿医学、精准营养、营养补剂与健康管理五大领域的中英文权威资讯，每条附原始出处链接。
intro_en: A daily digest of authoritative Chinese and international coverage across functional medicine, longevity medicine, precision nutrition, dietary supplements and health management — every item links to its original source.

items.title_zh: 咖啡酸修肠屏障：既「驯化」菌群，又直接按下 AHR 开关
items.title_en: Caffeic acid repairs the gut barrier by reshaping microbiota and directly activating AHR
items.source_zh: 腾讯新闻 · 热心肠日报
items.summary_zh: 广东医科大学罗连响团队在《Phytomedicine》报告，10—20 毫克/公斤咖啡酸可逆转结肠炎小鼠的大肠杆菌—志贺菌泛滥，富集双歧杆菌与杜氏杆菌，把色氨酸代谢从犬尿氨酸推向 5-羟色胺；粪菌移植即可复现屏障修复，而 AHR 基因沉默后保护作用消失，说明菌群重塑与受体激动两条通路缺一不可。
items.summary_en: A team at Guangdong Medical University reported in Phytomedicine that 10–20 mg/kg caffeic acid reversed Escherichia-Shigella overgrowth in colitis mice, enriched Bifidobacterium and Dubosiella, and shifted tryptophan metabolism from kynurenine toward serotonin. Faecal transplant reproduced the barrier repair, while AHR silencing abolished protection — showing both microbiota remodelling and receptor agonism are required.

items.title_zh: 「养菌」走红之后：益生菌证据有限，肠菌移植已进国家级目录
items.title_en: After the gut-health hype: probiotic evidence stays limited, while FMT enters a national catalogue
items.summary_zh: 秦环龙在光明网采访中提醒，菌群与焦虑、睡眠、认知的关联受到广泛关注，但饮食调菌能否直接改善这些疾病仍缺高质量临床研究。肠菌移植自 2026 年 5 月 1 日起作为独立大类纳入国家级备案目录，目前证据最明确的是复发性艰难梭菌感染；健康人不必为减肥或改善睡眠接受移植。
items.summary_en: In a Guangming Online interview, Qin Huanlong cautioned that links between the microbiome and anxiety, sleep and cognition are widely discussed but dietary modulation still lacks high-quality clinical evidence. Faecal microbiota transplantation has been a standalone category in the national filing catalogue since 1 May 2026, with recurrent C. difficile infection the best-supported indication; healthy people need not undergo FMT for weight loss or sleep.

items.title_zh: 熬夜加晚食可能「漏」出肠内毒素：节律错位与肠屏障的新证据
items.title_en: Late nights and late meals may leak endotoxin: new evidence on circadian misalignment and the gut barrier
items.summary_zh: 一项发表于 iScience 的人体研究把「昼夜节律—肠道屏障—微生态失衡—代谢炎症」串成一条完整链条：肥胖且晚睡型节律者肠道通透性升高，内毒素更易入血，炎症指标与菌群构成同步偏移。作者建议把主要能量摄入放在日间活动期，临床上应评估肠漏与炎症指标，而不是只计算卡路里。
items.summary_en: A human study in iScience links circadian misalignment, gut barrier integrity, microbial imbalance and metabolic inflammation into one chain: in obesity with late chronotype, intestinal permeability rises, endotoxin more readily enters circulation, and inflammatory markers shift alongside microbiome composition. The authors advise concentrating energy intake in the active daytime phase and assessing permeability rather than counting calories alone.

items.title_zh: 母乳源双歧杆菌 CP-9 婴幼儿多中心双盲试验：提升双歧杆菌、抑制条件致病菌
items.title_en: Human-milk-derived Bifidobacterium CP-9: multicentre double-blind infant trial raises bifidobacteria, suppresses pathobionts
items.summary_zh: 在 2026 特殊食品大会上，南京医科大学第二附属医院孙治平报告母乳源动物双歧杆菌乳亚种 CP-9 的婴幼儿多中心、双盲、随机平行对照研究：CP-9 提升肠道双歧杆菌丰度、抑制大肠杆菌等条件致病菌，双向调节菌群，在健康婴幼儿中安全性与耐受性良好；延伸研究还涉及缩短足月儿光疗时长与改善肥胖儿童脂代谢。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Special Food Conference, Sun Zhiping of Nanjing Medical University's Second Affiliated Hospital presented a multicentre, double-blind, randomised parallel-group infant study of human-milk-derived Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis CP-9: the strain raised bifidobacterial abundance, suppressed E. coli and other pathobionts, bidirectionally modulated the microbiota and was well tolerated in healthy infants. Extension work covers shorter phototherapy in term infants and lipid metabolism in obese children.

items.title_zh: 两篇《细胞》绘制灵长类大脑衰老图谱：女性大脑「老得更快」
items.title_en: Two Cell papers map primate brain ageing — and find female brains age faster at the molecular level
items.summary_zh: 两项背靠背的《细胞》研究用单细胞测序构建非人灵长类脑衰老图谱，覆盖多个脑区与数十万细胞：星形胶质、小胶质、少突胶质等支持细胞比多数神经元更敏感，前额叶变化最突出；65% 的年龄与性别交互效应在女性更强，且与阿尔茨海默病转录组显著趋同，提示性别应作为脑衰老研究的基本变量。
items.summary_en: Two back-to-back Cell studies used single-cell sequencing to build non-human primate brain ageing atlases across multiple regions and hundreds of thousands of cells: astrocytes, microglia and oligodendrocytes changed more than most neurons, with the prefrontal cortex most affected. Sixty-five percent of age-by-sex interaction effects were stronger in females, and changes converged with Alzheimer's transcriptomes, arguing that sex belongs among core ageing variables.

items.title_zh: 130 万国人数据：65 岁后「微胖」死亡风险更低，持续消瘦反而更危险
items.title_en: 1.3 million Chinese adults: after 65, being slightly overweight carries lower mortality than staying thin
items.summary_zh: 《npj 老龄化》一项追踪超 130 万国人的研究显示，与维持正常体重相比，持续低体重者死亡风险增加 61%，由正常转为低体重者增加 46%；稳定「微胖」者死亡风险降低 23%，由正常转为微胖者降低 25%。作者强调并非鼓励增肥，明显体重下降往往是健康恶化信号，其中呼吸系统死亡风险升高最显著。
items.summary_en: A study in npj Aging following more than 1.3 million Chinese adults found that, versus stable normal weight, persistently low weight raised mortality by 61% and shifting from normal to low weight by 46%, while stable mild overweight lowered risk by 23% and moving from normal to mild overweight by 25%. The authors stress this is not a licence to gain fat: marked weight loss often signals deteriorating health, with respiratory deaths rising most.

items.title_zh: 综述：怀孕会暂时「催老」约 20 岁，产后一年才逐步回落
items.title_en: Review: pregnancy temporarily adds about 20 years of biological age, recovering over the following year
items.summary_zh: 一项汇总十余项队列、覆盖数十万女性的综述显示，母体生物年龄随孕周上升，分娩前后达峰、较基线约高 20 岁，产后约一年逐步回落，孕早期甚至出现短暂「逆龄」。两次妊娠间隔短于 24 个月会打断回落过程，DunedinPACE 受影响最明显；孕前 BMI 偏高、睡眠不足与慢性压力都会拖慢恢复。
items.summary_en: A review pooling more than ten cohorts and hundreds of thousands of women shows maternal biological age climbing through pregnancy, peaking around delivery at roughly 20 years above baseline, then declining over about a year — with a brief dip early in gestation. Intervals shorter than 24 months interrupt recovery, most visibly on DunedinPACE; higher pre-pregnancy BMI, poor sleep and chronic stress also slow it.

items.title_zh: 雅诗兰黛设「皮肤长寿」研发平台：锁定 Sirtuins、AMPK 与 mTOR
items.title_en: Estée Lauder launches a skin longevity platform targeting Sirtuins, AMPK and mTOR
items.summary_zh: 雅诗兰黛集团在进博会发布科研平台 Mastering Skin Longevity，把研究重心从皱纹等表象前移到「皮肤长寿主调控因子」，聚焦 Sirtuins、AMPK、mTOR 三大系统及其与衰老标志的交互；上海与美国的 Longevity Labs 分工推进，五大品牌共享平台但保留各自方向，同期发布「皮肤长寿时钟」与科研白皮书。
items.summary_en: At the China International Import Expo, Estée Lauder Companies unveiled Mastering Skin Longevity, moving research upstream from wrinkles to master regulators of skin ageing — Sirtuins, AMPK and mTOR and their interplay with hallmarks of ageing. Longevity Labs in Shanghai and the United States split the work, five brands share the platform while keeping distinct directions, and a Skin Longevity Clock plus white paper were released.

items.title_zh: 3.8 万人 UK Biobank：血浆 DHA 高者衰弱风险低 18%
items.title_en: 38,000 UK Biobank participants: higher plasma DHA linked to 18% lower frailty risk
items.summary_zh: 韩国与美国团队分析 UK Biobank 38 577 名 40—69 岁非衰弱成人，中位随访 9.37 年、1 024 人发生衰弱。校正人口学、生活方式与健康状况后，血浆 DHA 较高者衰弱风险低 18%，其中体力活动不足风险低 24%、疲惫感低 15%；握力、步速与体重下降无显著关联。作者提示 DHA 或可作衰弱风险预测指标。
items.summary_en: Researchers in Korea and the United States analysed 38,577 non-frail UK Biobank participants aged 40–69 over a median 9.37 years, during which 1,024 became frail. After adjustment, higher plasma DHA was associated with 18% lower frailty risk, including 24% lower risk of low physical activity and 15% lower exhaustion; grip strength, walking speed and weight loss showed no significant link. DHA may help predict frailty risk.

items.title_zh: GLP-1 把零售货架「撑爆」：蛋白、纤维、肌酸、胶原成刚需
items.title_en: GLP-1 is stretching retail shelves: protein, fibre, creatine and collagen become staples
items.summary_zh: 在伦敦 Sports & Active Nutrition Summit 上，THG 产品总监 Brett Hamer 表示 GLP-1 药物放大了原本就存在的蛋白、胶原、纤维与肌酸趋势，英国零售商已为健康保健品类腾出五条货架，Boots 甚至用「GLP-1 支持」标识导购；MyProtein 上线 AI 助手后最高频提问是「服药期间能否吃某产品」。乳清价格翻倍也在推动替代蛋白。
items.summary_en: Speaking at the Sports & Active Nutrition Summit in London, THG product director Brett Hamer said GLP-1 drugs are turbo-charging existing protein, collagen, fibre and creatine trends: UK retailers now devote five aisles to health and wellness, and Boots signposts GLP-1 support products. The most common question to MyProtein's AI agent is whether a product is suitable while on GLP-1s, and whey prices that have doubled are pushing alternative proteins.

items.title_zh: 肌少症食养指南落地：每餐 20—25 克蛋白，三餐别再「集中补」
items.title_en: China's sarcopenia dietary guideline: 20–25 g protein per meal, not one protein-heavy dinner
items.summary_zh: 《成人肌少症食养指南（2026 年版）》提出，肾功能正常的肌少症人群每日蛋白按 1.2—1.5 克/公斤体重，优质蛋白占比 60% 以上，每餐 20—25 克更利于肌肉蛋白合成，60 公斤老人约需 72—90 克。指南引用的调查显示我国 60 岁以上人群患病率 5.7%—23.9%，并强调「合成代谢抵抗」下早餐缺蛋白会拉长分解窗口。
items.summary_en: China's 2026 dietary guideline for adult sarcopenia recommends 1.2–1.5 g/kg protein daily for patients with normal kidney function, with high-quality protein above 60% and 20–25 g per meal to maximise muscle protein synthesis — roughly 72–90 g for a 60 kg older adult. Cited surveys put prevalence among Chinese adults over 60 at 5.7%–23.9%, and the guideline notes that protein-free breakfasts lengthen net breakdown under anabolic resistance.

items.title_zh: 柬埔寨五成孕妇贫血：多种微量营养素补充剂将覆盖三分之一孕妇
items.title_en: Half of Cambodian pregnant women are anaemic: multiple micronutrient supplements to reach a third of them
items.summary_zh: Vitamin Angels 与柬埔寨卫生部合作扩大产前多种微量营养素补充剂（MMS，含 15 种维生素矿物质）的可及性，承诺逾 10 万瓶，2027 年预计覆盖该国近三分之一孕妇；当地约 51% 孕妇贫血，每年逾 3.73 万新生儿低出生体重。研究显示，相比单补铁叶酸，MMS 可降低婴儿死亡达 29%、贫血孕妇低出生体重达 19%。
items.summary_en: Vitamin Angels is partnering with Cambodia's Ministry of Health to scale up antenatal multiple micronutrient supplements (MMS, 15 vitamins and minerals), committing more than 100,000 bottles expected to reach nearly a third of pregnant women in 2027. About 51% of pregnant women there are anaemic and over 37,300 babies are born low birth weight each year; versus iron-folic acid alone, MMS cuts infant mortality by up to 29% and low birth weight by up to 19% in anaemic women.

items.title_zh: 总局通报 41 批次不合格：多款营养素液、特医食品含量不符
items.title_en: SAMR flags 41 non-compliant batches, including nutrient liquids and medical foods
items.summary_zh: 市场监管总局通报 1 459 批次抽检中 41 批次不合格，涉保健食品、特医食品与特殊膳食：某 N-乙酰神经氨酸多维饮叶酸既不符合国标也不符合标签标示，某钙锌硒维生素 D3 营养素液维生素 D 不达标，某液体微囊双铁能量饮铁含量与标签不符，另有特医增稠组件配方食品水分超标。属地监管部门已开展核查处置。
items.summary_en: China's market regulator reported 41 non-compliant batches out of 1,459 samples, spanning health foods, medical foods and foods for special dietary uses: folate in an N-acetylneuraminic acid multivitamin drink missed both national standards and label claims, vitamin D fell short in a calcium-zinc-selenium-D3 liquid, iron mismatched the label in a dual-iron energy drink, and a thickened medical food exceeded moisture limits. Local regulators have begun follow-up action.

items.title_zh: 龙口通报 6 起保健食品违法案例：过期、无台账、虚构功效全被罚
items.title_en: Longkou publishes six health-food enforcement cases: expired stock, missing records, invented claims
items.summary_zh: 山东龙口市市场监管局公布保健食品领域典型案例：销售过期三鞭酒且无进货查验记录、红牛维生素牛磺酸饮料超保质期、对产品功效作夸大误导宣传、网售未公示备案凭证、把普通蜂产品包装成具「调理」功能，以及药店经营过期食品、未建进货台账、无备案擅自经营预包装食品。监管部门重申保健食品不具疾病预防治疗功能。
items.summary_en: Longkou's market regulator in Shandong published representative health-food cases: expired tonic wine sold without purchase-verification records, out-of-date taurine drinks, exaggerated efficacy claims, online sales without a displayed filing certificate, ordinary bee products marketed as having regulatory effects, and a pharmacy selling expired food without purchase ledgers or filing. The regulator reiterated that health foods cannot prevent or treat disease.

items.title_zh: 调查：半数美国人信任 AI 健康建议，但只有 6% 愿意照做
items.title_en: Survey: half of Americans trust AI health advice, but only 6% would follow it over a doctor
items.summary_zh: Thorne 第二份《Wellness Compass》调查覆盖 3 004 名美国消费者：50% 表示信任 AI 提供健康与营养建议，较 2025 年升 6 个百分点；但当 AI 与医生意见冲突时，34% 选择听医生、仅 6% 选 AI，73% 更信任人类专家。54% 不确定自己适合哪种补剂，同样比例希望获得更个性化指导；Z 世代 41% 更信任部分网红。
items.summary_en: Thorne's second Wellness Compass survey of 3,004 US consumers found 50% trust AI for health and wellness advice, up six points from 2025. Yet when AI disagreed with their clinician, 34% sided with the clinician and only 6% with AI, while 73% trusted human experts more. Fifty-four percent were unsure which supplements suit them and the same share wanted more personalised guidance; 41% of Gen Z trust certain influencers more than their doctor.

items.title_zh: 新疆提示普通食品「功效化」乱象：驼乳粉、代用茶、膏方都在越界
items.title_en: Xinjiang warns on ordinary foods dressed up as remedies: camel milk powder, herbal teas, pastes
items.source_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区市场监督管理局
items.summary_zh: 新疆市场监管局梳理五类高频违法：普通食品标签标注治疗功能；驼乳粉、蜂蜜宣称「增强免疫力」却无蓝帽子；罗布麻茶、雪菊茶宣称「辅助降血压」；植物饮料、膏方宣称疏通血管、改善心梗；已备案保健食品超出备案功能宣传。监管部门提示认准批准文号与蓝帽子，留存宣传截图与订单凭证，可拨 12315 维权。
items.summary_en: Xinjiang's market regulator catalogued five recurring violations: treatment claims on ordinary food labels; camel milk powder and honey claiming immune enhancement without a blue-hat licence; herbal teas claiming to lower blood pressure; plant drinks and pastes claiming to unblock vessels or help heart attacks; and filed health foods promoted beyond their approved functions. Consumers are urged to check approval numbers, keep screenshots and receipts, and call 12315.

items.title_zh: 恩施市首家慢性病健康管理中心投用：四大功能区加双向转诊
items.title_en: Enshi opens its first chronic disease management centre with four zones and two-way referral
items.summary_zh: 恩施市舞阳坝社区卫生服务中心建成全市首家慢性病健康管理中心，设筛查监测、诊疗康复、健康宣教、家庭医生签约四大功能区，配眼底照相机、外周血管检测仪、体外反搏治疗仪，围绕高血压、糖尿病、慢阻肺建立登记建档到康复随访转诊的闭环，并按低危到很高危分级管理；同日揭牌州中心医院全科工作室，专家常态化坐诊。
items.summary_en: Wuyangba community health centre in Enshi has opened the city's first chronic disease management centre, with four zones for screening and monitoring, diagnosis and rehabilitation, health education, and family doctor contracting. Equipment includes fundus cameras, peripheral vascular detectors and enhanced external counterpulsation; hypertension, diabetes and COPD follow a closed loop from registration to rehabilitation, follow-up and referral, stratified from low to very high risk. A prefecture hospital general practice studio opened the same day.

items.title_zh: 湖南临澧：18 岁以上免费筛查，乡镇门诊量涨 35.2%
items.title_en: Linfi, Hunan: free screening for all adults, township outpatient visits up 35.2%
items.summary_zh: 临澧县自 2025 年底起为 18 岁以上常住居民免费筛查高血压、糖尿病、慢性肾脏病，开通两条免费健康公交专线、40 余个站点，家庭医生定期上门；县人民医院设慢病管理中心，免费筛查已超 1 万人，结果同步推送社区医生。组建整合 3 家县级医院、17 家乡镇卫生院的医共体后，乡镇卫生院门诊人次增长 35.2%，重点人群签约率 94.96%。
items.summary_en: Since late 2025, Linfi county in Hunan has offered free screening for hypertension, diabetes and chronic kidney disease to all residents over 18, running two free health bus routes with more than 40 stops and regular home visits by family doctors. The county hospital's chronic disease centre has screened over 10,000 people, with results pushed to community doctors. After forming a county medical community of three hospitals and 17 township clinics, township outpatient visits rose 35.2% and contracting among key groups reached 94.96%.

items.title_zh: 温州 202 家基层机构全建慢病一体化门诊：AI 智管平台同步落地
items.title_en: All 202 Wenzhou primary care sites now run integrated chronic disease clinics, backed by an AI platform
items.summary_zh: 温州以「诊前筛查—诊中诊疗—诊后随访」闭环重构基层慢病管理：瓯海娄桥中心诊间随访占比由 18.70% 升至 57.72%，平阳昆阳镇卫生院血压、血糖控制率分别提升 19.05 与 17.42 个百分点，鹿城双屿用动态血糖仪加 AI 助手按分钟生成血糖曲线。全市 202 家乡镇卫生院（社区卫生服务中心）已全部建成一体化门诊，慢病管理综合指数提升 13.8%。
items.summary_en: Wenzhou has rebuilt primary chronic disease care around a screening-diagnosis-follow-up loop: at Louqiao centre in Ouhai, in-consultation follow-up rose from 18.70% to 57.72%; Kunyang township clinic lifted blood pressure and glucose control rates by 19.05 and 17.42 percentage points; Shuangyu in Lucheng pairs continuous glucose monitors with an AI assistant generating minute-by-minute curves. All 202 township and community sites now run integrated clinics, and the city's chronic disease management index rose 13.8%.

items.title_zh: 家庭医生健康管理中心「建起来容易跑起来难」：四道堵点被摆上桌
items.title_en: Family doctor health centres: easy to build, hard to run — four bottlenecks laid out
items.summary_zh: 北京基层常见病防控能力提升培训班上，参会主任归纳家庭医生健康管理中心四大堵点：把中心做成设备陈列区而非高危筛查入口；诊疗数据碎片化、系统对接改造成本高；医护药多岗能力参差受木桶效应制约；运营质控与绩效激励难落地。破解思路是从「签而不约」转向「签而有感」，做诊前自测、诊中方案、诊后护理门诊的全流程闭环。
items.summary_en: At a Beijing primary care training session, centre directors identified four bottlenecks for family doctor health management centres: treating them as equipment showrooms rather than entry points for high-risk screening; fragmented clinical data with costly system integration; uneven capability across doctors, nurses and pharmacists that caps overall performance; and difficulty with quality control and incentive design. The proposed fix runs from paper contracts to felt benefit — pre-visit self-testing, in-visit plans and post-visit nurse-led clinics.
